Event Start

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	TFvw_CC_McVto_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_vw_CC_McVtoAuxDateText.InternalName)
	TFvw_CC_McFecha_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_vw_CC_McFechaAuxDateText.InternalName)
	TFvw_CC_FacVto_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_vw_CC_FacVtoAuxDateText.InternalName)
	TFvw_CC_FacFecha_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_vw_CC_FacFechaAuxDateText.InternalName)
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	Combo_CuentaCorrMedioCobroCod.HTMLTemplate = WWP_GetStyledDVCombo(!"Title and subtitle")
	
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName

	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = 'WWP_ExportCaption'
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = 'WWP_ExportReportCaption'
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	CuentaCorrFacturaFecha_RangePicker.Attach(&CuentaCorrFacturaFecha_RangeText.InternalName)
	CuentaCorrFacturaVto_RangePicker.Attach(&CuentaCorrFacturaVto_RangeText.InternalName)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	Form.Caption = 'Exportar Cuenta Corriente'

	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndEvent

Event Refresh

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'

	GridPaginationBar.EmptyGridCaption = iif(&LoadGridData, "WWP_PagingEmptyGridCaption", 'WWP_PressSearchToShowData')
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	If &LoadGridData
		&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	Else
		&GridAppliedFilters.SetEmpty()
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndEvent

Event 'DoSearch'

	IF not &ClienteId.IsEmpty()
		&TFvw_CC_Cliente = &ClienteId
		&TFvw_CC_Cliente_To = &ClienteId
	Endif

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&LoadGridData = True
	Refresh

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndEvent

Event GridPaginationBar.ChangePage

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndEvent

Event GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndEvent

Event DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_Estado'
					&TFvw_CC_Estado_SelsJson = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
					&TFvw_CC_Estado_Sels.FromJson(&TFvw_CC_Estado_SelsJson)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_Id'
					&TFvw_CC_Id.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_Id_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_Empresa'
					&TFvw_CC_Empresa.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_Empresa_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_Cliente'
					&TFvw_CC_Cliente.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_Cliente_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_ClieNombre'
					&TFvw_CC_ClieNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFvw_CC_ClieNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_ClieNroDoc'
					&TFvw_CC_ClieNroDoc.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_ClieNroDoc_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_FacTipo'
					&TFvw_CC_FacTipo = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFvw_CC_FacTipo_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_FacSerie'
					&TFvw_CC_FacSerie = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFvw_CC_FacSerie_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_FacSuc'
					&TFvw_CC_FacSuc.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_FacSuc_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_FacNro'
					&TFvw_CC_FacNro.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_FacNro_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_FacFecha'
					&TFvw_CC_FacFecha.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_FacFecha_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_FacVto'
					&TFvw_CC_FacVto.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_FacVto_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_FacMoneda'
					&TFvw_CC_FacMoneda = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFvw_CC_FacMoneda_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_FacTotal'
					&TFvw_CC_FacTotal.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_FacTotal_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_FacNroSAP'
					&TFvw_CC_FacNroSAP = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFvw_CC_FacNroSAP_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_McCod'
					&TFvw_CC_McCod = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFvw_CC_McCod_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_McNro'
					&TFvw_CC_McNro.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_McNro_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_McMoneda'
					&TFvw_CC_McMoneda = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFvw_CC_McMoneda_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_McTotal'
					&TFvw_CC_McTotal.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_McTotal_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_McFecha'
					&TFvw_CC_McFecha.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_McFecha_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_McVto'
					&TFvw_CC_McVto.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_McVto_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_DiasPago'
					&TFvw_CC_DiasPago.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_DiasPago_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_IntTipo'
					&TFvw_CC_IntTipo = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFvw_CC_IntTipo_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_IntNro'
					&TFvw_CC_IntNro.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_IntNro_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_Carrera'
					&TFvw_CC_Carrera.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_Carrera_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_CLCarreraId'
					&TFvw_CC_CLCarreraId = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFvw_CC_CLCarreraId_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_CLObs'
					&TFvw_CC_CLObs = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFvw_CC_CLObs_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_MaterialId'
					&TFvw_CC_MaterialId = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFvw_CC_MaterialId_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_CCostoId'
					&TFvw_CC_CCostoId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_CCostoId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_CCostoDesc'
					&TFvw_CC_CCostoDesc = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFvw_CC_CCostoDesc_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_FacDetPlanItem'
					&TFvw_CC_FacDetPlanItem.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_FacDetPlanItem_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_FacDetPlanId'
					&TFvw_CC_FacDetPlanId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFvw_CC_FacDetPlanId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_Texto'
					&TFvw_CC_Texto = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFvw_CC_Texto_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_Anulado'
					&TFvw_CC_Anulado = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFvw_CC_Anulado_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'vw_CC_ModalidadId'
					&TFvw_CC_ModalidadId = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFvw_CC_ModalidadId_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndEvent

Event Grid.Load

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&estadoAdmin = Format("%1 - %2", vw_CC_EstAdmId, vw_CC_EstAdmDesc)
	&estadoAcademico = Format("%1 - %2", vw_CC_EstAcaId, vw_CC_EstAcaDesc)
	&vw_CC_EstadoWithTags = trim(vw_CC_Estado.EnumerationDescription())
	If vw_CC_Estado = EstadoCuentaCorr.Aplica
		&vw_CC_EstadoWithTags += !"<span class='fa fa-circle FontColorIconSuccess FontColorIconSmall TagAfterText'></span>"
	EndIf
	If vw_CC_Estado = EstadoCuentaCorr.NoAplica
		&vw_CC_EstadoWithTags += !"<span class='fa fa-circle FontColorIconDanger FontColorIconSmall TagAfterText'></span>"
	EndIf
	If vw_CC_Estado = EstadoCuentaCorr.Anulada
		&vw_CC_EstadoWithTags += !"<span class='fa fa-circle FontColorIconSuccess FontColorIconSmall TagAfterText'></span>"
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndEvent

Event ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'BillerExterno.vw_CuentaCorrViewWWFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'BillerExterno.vw_CuentaCorrViewWWFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'BillerExterno.vw_CuentaCorrViewWWFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				&LoadGridData = True
				Grid.FirstPage()
			EndIf
	EndCase

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndEvent

Event 'DoBuscarCliente'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	Cliente.SeleccionCliente.PopUp(&ClienteId, &ClienteNombre)
	Refresh

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndEvent

Event ddo_AGExport.OnOptionClicked

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndEvent

Sub 'SetDDOSortedStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	DDO_Grid.SortedStatus = &OrderedBy.ToString().Trim() + !':' + iif(&OrderedDsc, !'DSC', !'ASC')

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadSavedFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ManageFiltersData = WWP_ManageFiltersLoadSavedFilters(!'BillerExterno.vw_CuentaCorrViewWWFilters', '', '', False)

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CleanFilters'

	&ClienteId.SetEmpty()
	&ClienteNombre.SetEmpty()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&FilterFullText.SetEmpty()
	&CuentaCorrCarrera = new()
	Combo_CuentaCorrCarrera.SelectedValue_set = ''
	&CuentaCorrCL_CarreraId = new()
	Combo_CuentaCorrCL_CarreraId.SelectedValue_set = ''
	&CuentaCorrMedioCobroCod = new()
	Combo_CuentaCorrMedioCobroCod.SelectedValue_set = ''
	&CuentaCorrFacturaFecha.SetEmpty()
	&CuentaCorrFacturaFecha_To.SetEmpty()
	&CuentaCorrFacturaVto.SetEmpty()
	&CuentaCorrFacturaVto_To.SetEmpty()
	&TFvw_CC_Estado_Sels = new()
	&TFvw_CC_Id.SetEmpty()
	&TFvw_CC_Id_To.SetEmpty()
	&TFvw_CC_Empresa.SetEmpty()
	&TFvw_CC_Empresa_To.SetEmpty()

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(&PgmName + !"GridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(&PgmName + !"GridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(&PgmName + !"GridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
	Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
	If not &GridState.PageSize.Trim().IsEmpty()
		Grid.Rows = &GridState.PageSize.ToNumeric()
	EndIf
	Grid.CurrentPage = &GridState.CurrentPage

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadRegFiltersState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"CUENTACORRCARRERA"
				&CuentaCorrCarrera.FromJson(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"CUENTACORRCL_CARRERAID"
				&CuentaCorrCL_CarreraId.FromJson(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)

Sub 'PrepareTransaction'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TrnContext = new()
	&TrnContext.CallerObject = &Pgmname
	&TrnContext.CallerOnDelete = True
	&TrnContext.CallerURL = &HTTPRequest.ScriptName + !"?" + &HTTPRequest.QueryString
	&TrnContext.TransactionName = !"BillerExterno.vw_CuentaCorrView"

	&Session.Set(!"TrnContext", &TrnContext.ToXml())

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'DoExport'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Generate Excel spreadsheet and download it.
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	BillerExterno.vw_CuentaCorrViewWWExport.Call(&ExcelFilename, &ErrorMessage)
	If (&ExcelFilename <> "")
		Link(&ExcelFilename)
	Else
		msg(&ErrorMessage)
	Endif

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'DoExportReport'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Generate PDF file.
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	InNewWindow1.Target = BillerExterno.vw_CuentaCorrViewWWExportReport.Link()
	InNewWindow1.Height = !'600'
	InNewWindow1.Width = !'800'
	InNewWindow1.OpenWindow()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadComboCuentaCorrMedioCobroCod'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&CuentaCorrMedioCobroCod_Data = new()
	For Each
		Order MedioCobreoDescripcion
		Option Distinct
		&Combo_DataItem = new()
		&Combo_DataItem.ID = MedioCobroCod
		&ComboTitles = new()
		&ComboTitles.Add(MedioCobreoDescripcion)
		&ComboTitles.Add(MedioCobroCod)
		&Combo_DataItem.Title = &ComboTitles.ToJson()
		&CuentaCorrMedioCobroCod_Data.Add(&Combo_DataItem)
	EndFor
	Combo_CuentaCorrMedioCobroCod.SelectedValue_set = &CuentaCorrMedioCobroCod.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadComboCuentaCorrCL_CarreraId'

	&CuentaCorrCL_CarreraId_Data.Clear()

	For each Cliente.Cliente.Carrera
		Where ClienteId = &ClienteId
		Where CarreraId in &CuentaCorrCarrera

		&Combo_DataItem = New()

		&Combo_DataItem.ID = CL_carreraId.Trim()
		&Combo_DataItem.ID = &Combo_DataItem.ID.Trim()
		&Combo_DataItem.Title = CL_carreraId + " (" +  ModalidadId + " )"

		&CuentaCorrCL_CarreraId_Data.Add(&Combo_DataItem)

	When none

		For each Codificadores.Carrera.CL_carrera
			Where CarreraId in &CuentaCorrCarrera

			&Combo_DataItem = New()

			&Combo_DataItem.ID = CL_carreraId
			&Combo_DataItem.Title = CL_carreraId

			&CuentaCorrCL_CarreraId_Data.Add(&Combo_DataItem)
		EndFor
	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	//&CuentaCorrCL_CarreraId_Data has to be loaded manually at the beginning of this Subrutine
	&CuentaCorrCL_CarreraId_Data.Sort(!'Title')
	Combo_CuentaCorrCL_CarreraId.SelectedValue_set = &CuentaCorrCL_CarreraId.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadComboCuentaCorrCarrera'

	&CuentaCorrCarrera_Data.Clear()

	For each Cliente.Cliente.Carrera
		Unique CarreraCombo, CarreraId

		&Combo_DataItem = New()

		&Combo_DataItem.ID = CarreraId.ToString()
		&Combo_DataItem.Title = CarreraCombo

		&CuentaCorrCarrera_Data.Add(&Combo_DataItem)
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	//&CuentaCorrCarrera_Data has to be loaded manually at the beginning of this Subrutine
	&CuentaCorrCarrera_Data.Sort(!'Title')
	Combo_CuentaCorrCarrera.SelectedValue_set = &CuentaCorrCarrera.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub
